        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int b = sc.nextInt();
        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }

        int odd = 0, even = 0;
        List<Integer> candidates = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
            if (a[i] % 2 == 0) even++;
            else odd++;

            if (odd == even) {
                candidates.add(Math.abs(a[i + 1] - a[i]));
            }
        }

        Collections.sort(candidates, Collections.reverseOrder());
        int remainingBudget = b;
        int count = 0;
        while (!candidates.isEmpty() && remainingBudget >= candidates.get(candidates.size() - 1)) {
            int cost = candidates.remove(candidates.size() - 1);
            remainingBudget -= cost;
            count++;
        }

        System.out.println(count);
    }
}
